entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature

Mass 1.211 (1.171 to 1.251) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source). entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,302.74 K and log g 4.2 (u1 0.371, u2 0.307): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
